# Volume models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

2 volume models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: a CT volume `[D, H, W]` in Hounsfield units and its voxel spacing in mm (`volume.read_nifti` reads both from a NIfTI file). Output: a class index per voxel `[D, H, W]` on the input grid (0 = background).

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 300x300: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured.

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

| model | commercial |
|---|---|

<a id="totalsegmentator"></a>

## TotalSegmentator

TotalSegmentator (University Hospital Basel): nnU-Net v2 networks that label 117 anatomical structures (organs, bones, muscles, vessels) in CT volumes, at 1.5 mm (five networks) or 3 mm (one, faster). Commercially usable (Apache-2.0 code and weights).

Commercial use: yes.

Speed and memory not measured for: `totalsegmentator-total`, `totalsegmentator-total-3mm`.

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Paper: [TotalSegmentator: Robust Segmentation of 104 Anatomic Structures in CT Images](https://doi.org/10.1148/ryai.230024), Radiology: Artificial Intelligence 2023, 2023-07-05
- Paper: [nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-020-01008-z), Nature Methods 2021, 2020-12-07
- Original code: <https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator> at `184fa4765456`
- Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: `LICENSE`
- Weights licence: Apache-2.0
- Licence evidence: https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator/blob/184fa4765456492b2ab81a981cc387465906b003/LICENSE ; https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator/blob/184fa4765456492b2ab81a981cc387465906b003/README.md
- Training data: TotalSegmentator dataset v2 (1228 CT scans, 117 structures) (1559 CT scans of the TotalSegmentator dataset v2 (CC BY 4.0). Only the weights licence counts for the commercial flag.)
- Kernel libraries: `vol_norm`
- Variants: `totalsegmentator-total`, `totalsegmentator-total-3mm`
- Outputs: labels
- Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `totalsegmentator-total` not measured yet; `totalsegmentator-total-3mm` not measured yet

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.003 and p99 <= 0.5 (absolute error of the output `labels`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `totalsegmentator-total` | 7e-05 / 0.0 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `vol_norm@44036d4da567:sm_120` |
| `totalsegmentator-total-3mm` | 0.0006 / 0.0 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `vol_norm@44036d4da567:sm_120` |

</details>
